content.title: Pass a line
content.summary: Three people write a story one line at a time, seeing only the preceding line until the reveal.
content.setup: Invite three people and choose their turn order.
content.prompt: A mysterious package arrived at the door.
content.participant: When it is your turn, read the starting prompt or the preceding person's line and add one line of your own.
content.completion: After the third line, the app reveals the ordered story to the group.
content.access: Participants need a way to read and write text. A turn has no timeout in this version, so the activity can wait indefinitely for its current participant.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.
